title: Mixed demo (English questions, Chinese explanations)
description: Test data: English prompts and options with Simplified Chinese source explanations, like a CISSP bank annotated in Chinese. Not real exam questions.

aiAnalysis.note: Advisory only; scoring uses the source answer.

questions.prompt: Which of the following BEST describes the purpose of a security policy?

options.label: A
options.text: To define management's intent for protecting information

options.label: B
options.text: To list every technical control in use

questions.explanation: 安全策略是管理层对信息安全的意图声明，这是网络安全治理的基础。

ai.explanation: A security policy states management intent; the other options are lower-level artifacts.

questions.prompt: Which protocol provides confidentiality for web traffic?
questions.explanation: TLS 为传输层提供加密，保护网络通信的机密性。

questions.prompt: Who is ultimately responsible for the security of an organization's information?
questions.explanation: 高级管理层对组织的信息安全负最终责任。

questions.prompt: Which device operates mainly at the network layer?
questions.explanation: 路由器工作在网络层，根据 IP 地址转发数据包。

questions.prompt: What is the main goal of software security testing?
questions.explanation: 软件安全测试的目的是在发布前发现漏洞，这对开发过程很重要。
